rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad to hear it, and thank you for offering — concrete help is exactly what's useful right now. Here's a first task, sized for a few hours: a short landscape scan of AI safety measurement/evals. Specifically — what's already being measured (which orgs, which benchmarks, roughly what they cover), versus what capable people keep saying nobody is measuring yet. I'd love a one-pager at the end: 5-10 candidate \"neglected measurement target\" ideas, a sentence on why each is neglected, and a rough sense of what a first version would take to build. No rush on an exact deadline, but if two weeks works for you that'd be great. Feel free to ask me questions as you go rather than guessing — I'd rather you spend the time on the substance. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (she offered volunteer time) with a concrete first task: a short scan of what's already measured in AI safety vs. what's neglected, one-pager in ~2 weeks.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon Threshold weekly check-in" (0 14 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
